waypoints.name: High Bridge / Agnes Creek Trailhead (Stehekin Valley Road)
waypoints.note: Reached only via Lady of the Lake ferry from Chelan to Stehekin (no road access), then NPS shuttle bus up-valley to High Bridge; hike Agnes Creek Trail ~5mi to Five Mile/Swamp Creek Camp, then follow the abandoned, overgrown Swamp Creek Trail/drainage up to the Dark Glacier.
waypoints.directions: No road reaches this trailhead. Get to Stehekin from Chelan on the Lake Chelan passenger ferry (Lady Express about 2.5 hours, Lady II about 4 hours) or by floatplane, then ride the scheduled Stehekin Valley shuttle bus up-valley to High Bridge at 1,700 ft, which is the end of the road and the start of the Agnes Creek Trail. Both the ferry and the shuttle run fixed, limited daily schedules and the whole itinerary is built around them, so book ahead. The valley road and area trails took heavy flood and debris-flow damage in December 2025, so confirm current conditions with the park before committing.

waypoints.name: Dark Glacier
waypoints.directions: From High Bridge follow the Agnes Creek Trail (PCT) south about 5 to 5.5 miles to Fivemile Camp at 2,200 ft, then roughly 3 miles further, 8 to 9 miles total, to Swamp Creek Camp at 2,800 ft. Leave the maintained trail there for the long-abandoned Swamp Creek climbers' path: cross Swamp Creek on a large log to its east side, force about a quarter mile of dense slide alder and vine maple, and continue cross-country from the lower basin up to the upper basin at roughly 4,300 ft, which trip reports put at another 4 to 5 hours. From the upper basin kick steps up around 3,000 ft of steep, often snow-covered ground with no established track to Dark Fin Col, then rope up and descend a loose slope off the col onto the glacier, watching for wet rock below the snow slabs. Many parties instead stay on the PCT about 12.5 miles to Hemlock Camp and climb northwest through open forest and slopes, roughly 3,500 ft of gain, straight to the col, which avoids most of the Swamp Creek brush.

waypoints.name: Dark Peak Summit
waypoints.directions: Cross the Dark Glacier as a roped team, gaining from roughly 7,000 ft to 8,250 ft and picking a line through the crevasses. Several parties report the right side of the glacier as the cleaner passage, and crevasses are best bridged early to mid season, with more of them open by late summer. Finish with a belayed crossing of the summit moat and bergschrund onto the rock ridge, which is the technical crux, then scramble a short section of rock to the true summit at 8,504 ft.
